$comment: Named exceptions to the campus CTA rows of the check bundle (campus.resources.booking.*, campus.resources.calendar.*, campus.resources.packet.*, campus.resources.apply.*, and the Join the Community CTA row), keyed by campus slug (registry/campus-pages.json) and CTA. An entry records a decision a person made about one CTA on one campus page: who decided, where it was said (channel and date), when it ends, and why. agent/file-observer-findings.mjs reads this file through each row's exemptionsRef: a finding whose campus and CTA carry an unexpired entry is reported as exempted and never filed. Rules: hidden (the CTA is intentionally not shown; every row of that CTA is exempt), present (the CTA is intentionally shown although the requirement would not call for it; only the CTA's present rows are exempt, reachability and destination still apply), destination (the CTA points at a decided non-standard destination; only the destination rows named under rules.destination are exempt, presence and reachability still apply). expires is an ISO date (the exception ends at the start of that day, UTC), lifecycle:Open (it ends when the HubSpot Program type becomes Open, read from the finding, else spec/campus-lifecycle.json), or null (standing until a recorded decision revokes it). Add or change an entry with agent/record-decision.mjs, which also writes the docs/decisions.md row; never by hand without the decision row. Schema: spec/schemas/campus-cta-exceptions.schema.json; validated by npm run validate.

hidden.meaning: The CTA is intentionally not shown on this campus page. Every row of the CTA is exempt: a missing button is the decided state, and nothing can be reachable or campus-specific when nothing is shown.

present.meaning: The CTA is intentionally shown although the lifecycle requirement would not call for it. Only the CTA's present rows are exempt; the destination must still be reachable and campus-specific.

destination.meaning: The CTA points at a decided non-standard destination (recorded in the entry's destination field). The destination comparison rows are exempt; the button must still be present where required and must still answer 2xx logged out. (cta is the Join the Community row, whose whole comparison is the destination host).
